verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser exposes a documented REST/SDK API (single API calls to start agent tasks, page.ai(), page.extract()), a public SDK on npm confirmed to install and export a client class, and a documented MCP server confirmed at runtime to run and respond over stdio — all clear evidence of a documented public API for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probes returned 404) and independent hands-on API-usage corroboration beyond docs/probes.
